description: This file defines a configuration structure and static utility functions related to sharing gateway relay settings, including storing and retrieving configuration data and last event information via UserDefaults.

classes.name: ShareGatewayRelayConfig
classes.description: A data structure holding configuration details for the relay setup

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the relay configuration from user defaults

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the relay configuration to user defaults

methods.name: clearConfig
methods.description: Removes the relay configuration from user defaults

methods.name: saveLastEvent
methods.description: Stores the last event message with a timestamp

methods.name: loadLastEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored event message
